subject: error message using geom_text with grouped data

messages.author: ba35b9efc4419988
messages.subject: error message using geom_text with grouped data
parts:
Hi

I'm having problems adding text to a plot. Here's a simplified
reconstruction of what I'm trying to do:

tm<-1:10
v1<-rnorm(10)
v2<-rnorm(10)
v3<-rnorm(10)
dat<-data.frame(tm,v1,v2,v3)

ag<-c(2,5,9)
lbl<-c("A","A","B")
labl<-data.frame(ag,lbl)

dm<-melt(dat, id=1)
p<-ggplot(dm, aes(tm, value, group=variable))
p + geom_line(aes(colour=variable))
last_plot() + geom_text(aes(x=ag, y=-2, label=lbl), data=labl)

This then returns the error message: "Error in eval(expr, envir,
enclos) : object 'variable' not found"

Does anyone know of a better way to do this please? (i.e. one that
works!)
Thanks
Eve

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: error message using geom_text with grouped data
parts:
Hi,

The problem you have is that your first line, ggplot(dm, aes(tm,
value, group=variable)), defines some global aesthetic mapping for the
plot. These mappings don't work with the last geom you want to use
(hence it fails to find a "variable").

You have at least three options:

1- move all aes() in the geom,

p<-ggplot(dm)
p + geom_line(aes(tm, value, group=variable, colour=variable))
2- overwrite the mapping for the last geom,

last_plot() + geom_text(aes(x=ag, y=-2, label=lbl, group=NA), data=labl)


3- use annotate()

p <- ggplot(dm, aes(tm, value, group=variable))
p + geom_line(aes(colour=variable))
last_plot() + annotate(geom="text",x=ag, y=-2, label=lbl)



HTH,


baptiste
